name: runwatch
description: Watch Terrakube jobs, Jenkins builds, GitHub PR checks and Actions runs in a pane, and get told when they finish or need you

pollSeconds.title: Check every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often each running watch is checked. Lower is livelier and calls the services more.

toast.title: Toast
toast.description: The in-terminal toast. always: when any run finishes or waits for approval. failures: only when one fails or waits for approval. off: none.

notify.title: Desktop notification
notify.description: always: when any run finishes or waits for approval. failures: only when one fails or waits for approval. off: none.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A short chime: rising on pass, falling on fail, a double tone on approval. always, failures (fails and approvals) or off.

wakeClaude.title: Tell Claude when its runs finish
wakeClaude.description: When a run Claude handed to the watch tool finishes, send Claude the result so it can carry on.

openPane.title: Open the pane on a new watch
openPane.description: Open the runwatch pane by itself when a watch starts. Off: use /watch to open it.

show.title: Show watches from
show.description: all: runs from every project, others tagged with their folder. project: only runs started in this session's project.

keepDoneHours.title: Keep finished runs (hours)
keepDoneHours.description: Finished runs stay listed, across sessions, this long before they are dropped.

toastSeconds.title: Toast duration (seconds)
toastSeconds.description: How long the in-terminal toast stays up when a run finishes or waits.

terrakubeScript.title: terrakube.sh path
terrakubeScript.description: Leave empty to find the terrakube skill's script in the plugin cache.

jenkinsScript.title: jenkins.sh path
jenkinsScript.description: Leave empty to find the jenkins skill's script in the plugin cache.
